name: CrowdRelay — VIRYA OS funding package executor
description: Builds a deterministic Markdown funding package on Drive. Does not submit legal declarations.

parameters.jsCode: const e=$json;if(!e||e.type!=='viryaos.funding.package_requested'||e.version!==1) throw new Error('Unsupported funding package event');const d=e.data??{};if(!d.opportunity_id||!d.title||!d.deadline) throw new Error('Invalid funding package payload');const f=d.facts&&typeof d.facts==='object'?d.facts:{};const money=n=>`${(Number(n||0)/100).toFixed(2)} ${d.currency||'PLN'}`;const lines=[`# VIRYA — pakiet wniosku: ${d.title}`,'',`**Organizacja:** ${d.organization||'-'}`,`**Deadline:** ${d.deadline}`,`**Wnioskowana kwota:** ${money(d.funding_amount_minor)}`,`**Wkład własny:** ${money(d.own_contribution_minor)}`,`**Źródło:** ${d.destination_url||'-'}`,'','## Dane kanoniczne','',...Object.entries(f).sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b)).map(([k,v])=>`- **${k}:** ${typeof v==='object'?JSON.stringify(v):String(v)}`),'','## Checklist','- [ ] opis projektu zweryfikowany','- [ ] harmonogram zweryfikowany','- [ ] budżet zweryfikowany','- [ ] załączniki kompletne','- [ ] oświadczenia prawne zatwierdzone przez człowieka','','_Pakiet wygenerowany deterministycznie przez VIRYA OS. Finalne złożenie wymaga APPROVAL._'];const md=lines.join('\n');const safe=String(d.title).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9ąćęłńóśźżĄĆĘŁŃÓŚŹŻ _.-]/g,'').trim().slice(0,90)||'funding';const fileName=`VIRYA-funding-${safe}-${d.opportunity_id}.md`;return [{json:{event_id:e.id,action_id:d.action_id,opportunity_id:d.opportunity_id,fileName},binary:{data:{data:Buffer.from(md,'utf8').toString('base64'),mimeType:'text/markdown',fileName}}}];

const src=$('Build deterministic funding package').item.json||{};const out=$json||{};return [{json:{action_id:src.action_id,claim_token:$('Resolve provider execution claim').item.json.claim_token,status:'succeeded',provider_reference:String(out.id||out.webViewLink||out.name||src.fileName||'drive').slice(0,240),metadata:{event_id:src.event_id,provider:'google_drive',domain_transition:'package_ready'},occurred_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
const src=$('Resolve provider execution claim').item.json||{}; throw new Error(`Provider outcome ambiguous for action ${src.action_id||'unknown'}; claim retained to prevent automatic duplicate`);
